1. Assign Telegram credentials to all Telegram nodes.
2. Assign PostgreSQL credentials to all Postgres nodes.
3. Use PostgreSQL credential name: `kovach_bot_db`.
4. Create tables: `bot_users`, `lead_requests`, `chat_sessions`, `bot_events`.
5. Replace placeholder texts, menu copy, and callback keys.
6. Extend the handoff branch with `createForumTopic` and real topic relay logic.

Set - Normalize Telegram Update

parameters.query:
SELECT
  {{ $json.user_id }}::bigint AS user_id,
  {{ $json.chat_id }}::bigint AS chat_id,
  u.language,
  u.state,
  u.funnel_stage,
  u.entry_point,
  (u.user_id IS NOT NULL) AS user_exists,
  s.message_thread_id,
  COALESCE(s.status, 'closed') AS handoff_status,
  COALESCE((s.status = 'open'), false) AS handoff_open
FROM (SELECT 1) seed
LEFT JOIN bot_users u
  ON u.user_id = {{ $json.user_id }}::bigint
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT message_thread_id, status
  FROM chat_sessions
  WHERE user_id = {{ $json.user_id }}::bigint
    AND status = 'open'
  ORDER BY created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
) s ON true;

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO bot_users (
  user_id,
  chat_id,
  username,
  first_name,
  last_name,
  language,
  state,
  funnel_stage,
  entry_point,
  last_seen_at,
  created_at,
  updated_at
)
VALUES (
  {{ $('Set - Normalize Telegram Update').item.json.user_id }}::bigint,
  {{ $('Set - Normalize Telegram Update').item.json.chat_id }}::bigint,
  '{{ String($('Set - Normalize Telegram Update').item.json.username || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ String($('Set - Normalize Telegram Update').item.json.first_name || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ String($('Set - Normalize Telegram Update').item.json.last_name || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  'ru',
  'new',
  'visitor',
  '{{ String($('Set - Normalize Telegram Update').item.json.entry_point || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  NOW(),
  NOW(),
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING user_id, chat_id, language, state, funnel_stage;

assignments.name: intent_key
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const raw = String($('Set - Normalize Telegram Update').item.json.callback_data || $('Set - Normalize Telegram Update').item.json.text_normalized || '').trim().toLowerCase(); if (!raw) return 'unknown'; if (raw === '/start' || raw === 'start') return 'start'; if (['main_menu','menu_main','главное меню','main menu','glavni meni'].includes(raw) || raw.includes('главное меню')) return 'main_menu'; if (['back','назад','back','nazad'].includes(raw)) return 'back'; if (['change_language','language','switch_language','сменить язык','язык','change language','language settings','promeni jezik','jezik'].includes(raw) || raw.includes('change language') || raw.includes('promeni jezik')) return 'change_language'; if (['set_lang_ru','lang_ru','русский','russian','ruski'].includes(raw)) return 'set_lang_ru'; if (['set_lang_en','lang_en','english','английский','engleski'].includes(raw)) return 'set_lang_en'; if (['set_lang_sr','lang_sr','serbian','serbian language','сербский','srpski'].includes(raw)) return 'set_lang_sr'; if (['menu_usecases','📚 юзкейсы','юзкейсы','use cases','studije slucaja'].includes(raw) || raw.includes('юзкейс') || raw.includes('use case') || raw.includes('studije')) return 'menu_usecases'; if (['case_1','кейс №1','case #1','slucaj #1'].includes(raw)) return 'case_1'; if (['case_2','кейс №2','case #2','slucaj #2'].includes(raw)) return 'case_2'; if (['case_3','кейс №3','case #3','slucaj #3'].includes(raw)) return 'case_3'; if (['case_4','кейс №4','case #4','slucaj #4'].includes(raw)) return 'case_4'; if (['menu_hot_news','hot news','🔥 hot news'].includes(raw)) return 'menu_hot_news'; if (['menu_contacts','контакты','contacts','kontakti','contact'].includes(raw) || raw.includes('контакт')) return 'menu_contacts'; if (['menu_creative','креатив','creative','kreativa'].includes(raw)) return 'menu_creative'; if (['reset_memory','сбросить память','reset memory','resetuj memoriju'].includes(raw)) return 'reset_memory'; if (raw === 'talk_to_manager' || raw.includes('менеджер') || raw.includes('связаться') || raw.includes('manager') || raw.includes('agent') || raw.includes('menadžer') || raw.includes('kontaktiraj')) return 'talk_to_manager'; return 'unknown'; })() }}
